title: SPACE cancellation, recovery, completion, and file publication boundaries

categories.prompt: Change workspace authority or cancel execute_code while SPACE adapter initialization is pending. Resolving initialization must not dispatch stale code; cleanup must dispose the eventual adapter exactly once.

executableTestNames: disposes an initializing adapter before stale workspace code can run
honors caller cancellation while adapter initialization is pending

categories.prompt: Fail journal writes before creation and after a create reply. No initial durable intent means no remote request. A later failure must retain the original create key so reconnect can reconcile and delete without replaying a command or creating a second VM.

executableTestNames: does not create a VM when the initial journal write fails (persistent=%s)
preserves a recoverable intent if journaling fails after creation
recovers a lost create reply with the same key and never creates a second VM
reconciles failed cleanup after reconnect without replaying a command

categories.prompt: Keep SSE open after a valid matching process_exited event, and separately interrupt an unfinished attachment with a deadline. The terminal event completes immediately; the unfinished deadline retains TimeoutError and never becomes success.

executableTestNames: finishes on a validated terminal event even if SSE remains open
retains TimeoutError when a deadline interrupts an attached response body
requires matching exit identity and a known completion status

categories.prompt: Replace the selected workspace or output parent during remote execution, revoke local write permission, or create the output locally. Publication must fail without overwriting user files, and recovery must preserve already-published files without republishing them.

executableTestNames: rejects replacement of the selected %s directory during a run
never overwrites user content and records partial publication without deleting it
additionalExecutableTestNames: revalidates local write authority after remote work completes
refuses an output created locally during execution
retains confirmed partial publication across recovery without deleting or republishing it

notes: These scenarios document review findings in a new opt-in feature, not a reported deployment incident. The referenced Vitest tests provide executable coverage; this JSON specification is not automatically executed by run_eval_suite.cjs. The HTTP/SSE fixture uses synthetic local guest commands and does not prove Firecracker, tenant, or egress isolation.
